title: feat(metadata-protocol,objectql): an object extension is an authorable item of a writable package, saved, published and exported through the existing doors (#28574)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XT6ZDDQFYhmZ6kxDp4hSdwM)_ Fixes #28574 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: added ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：对象扩展（`object_extension`，即「给别的包的对象加字段和规则」）成了可写包里的普通元数据项：通过现有的 `/api/v1/meta` 草稿、发布、历史回滚和删除口保存；发布后整个扩展体注册为该包的 `extend` 贡献者，字段出现在对象的每一种读取里，表也加上列；删除或卸载包时撤回；包导出把它带成 `objectExtensions`，可以再装回去。 - **为什么改**：Studio 在基础对象上「加字段」（N-23c）要写的就是这个：写进基础包配对的 `.custom` 包、字段带 `__c` 后缀、基础包不动（ADR-0146 D10）。以前这类数据只能由代码包的 manifest 带进来，运行时没有保存口。 - **风险与回滚**：只影响新类型 `object_extension` 的行；manifest 里的 `objectExtensions` 注册方式不变。顺带修正导出：一个包扩展了别人的对象时，导出不再把那个对象当成自己的对象输出（以前再安装会被所有权冲突拒绝）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：① `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`（保存/发布/回滚口的拒绝顺序与注册体）；② `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 里 `registerStoredObjectExtension` / `resyncStoredObjectExtensions` 和列表合并 `listSlotNameOf` 那几处；③ `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的导出循环（`objectExtensions` 一腿和 `objects` 只留自有对象的过滤）。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`，预期 19 个测试全绿。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **The type** (`packages/spec`, the one hunk seat 1 ruled, shape A): `object_extension` joins `MetadataTypeSchema` and `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`allowRuntimeCreate: true`, `supportsVersioning: true`, no overlay, `domain: 'data'`, `filePatterns: ['**/*.extension.ts']`, the convention of the one code file that holds an extension, `examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts`; the registry pin `metadata-plugin.test.ts` requires a pattern on every entry), plus the one classification row the `satisfies` (a record over every `MetadataType`) on `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` compile-forces: `object_extension: { disposition: 'excluded', basis: 'adr_0146_d10_extended' }`. Regenerated: `meta-url-data.generated.ts` (`gen:meta-url-spelling`) and the two reference pages `check:generated` named (`gen:docs`). No other spec key, no new error code, `ObjectExtensionSchema` untouched. The route ledger, SDK and OpenAPI did not move. `examples/app-showcase/src/coverage.ts` gains the `KIND_COVERAGE` entry the closed kind roster requires (admitted by the same ruling). - **The gate** — `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts` (new), asked by the save door, the per-item publish door and the history restore (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts`), beside the `__c` judge it calls. `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 with an issue path, in this order: a write bound to no package; the registry's own `defaultRowScope` / `membershipKeys` refusals with their sentences (`extendContributionRefusal`, now one exported function in `objectql/src/registry.ts` that `registerObject` also calls); a row filed under a name other than its `extend`; an unregistered target; a target outside the written package's closure (`narrowObjectsToPackageClosure`, with `closureDependencyRemedy`'s prescription); the `__c` judge from #28564 (`judgeExtensionFieldSuffix`), unchanged. The body's shape is the doors' own schema gate (`resolveOverlaySchema` → `ObjectExtensionSchema`, strict, over the body with the ADR-0010 envelope peeled off): 422 `INVALID_METADATA`. - **Registration** — `registerStoredObjectExtension` registers the WHOLE parsed body (`ObjectExtensionSchema` output, `_provenance: 'org'`) through `SchemaRegistry.registerObjectExtension` → `registerObject(..., 'extend', priority)`. Called from the mutation sync (`applyRegistryWriteThrough`) and the stored-row hydration every boot / reload path shares (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`). The manifest loop in `engine.ts` is not touched: what a manifest extension registers is unchanged. - **Withdrawal** — `restoreArtifactRegistryView` (the delete and uninstall heal) calls `resyncStoredObjectExtensions(target)`: it withdraws every stored-row (`_provenance: 'org'`) `extend` contributor of the target whose package has no active row left (`SchemaRegistry.withdrawObjectExtension`, new) and re-registers the rows that remain. Code-package contributors are never withdrawn. - **Storage** — `ensureObjectStorage` syncs the target's table on an `object_extension` publish, so a record can store the new field without a restart. - **List reads** — an `object_extension` body carries `extend` and no `name` (its schema refuses one), so `mergePackageAwareOverlay` slotted none of them and the list and per-package reads answered `[]`. `listSlotNameOf` slots such a body by its target. The body is served as stored: no `name` is added, so what GET answers PUTs back through the strict schema. - **Export** — `assemblePackageManifest` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) reads the package's `object_extension` items (per-package layer) into `objectExtensions`. Measured on base `7a48bf73`: it did NOT carry them (the base-red export test). And a package's `objects` keep only the objects it owns: the registry lists an object under every contributing package, so an extending package exported the target as its own object, and re-install refused it with `ObjectOwnershipConflictError`. - **Reference index** — `reference-sites.ts` walks `object_extension` with `ObjectExtensionSchema` (the type is deliberately not in `BUILTIN_METADATA_TYPE_SCHEMAS`), which keeps the `unwalkableSourceTypes` pin at exactly `['external_catalog']` instead of widening it. - **Translations** (`packages/platform-objects`): the metadata-forms bundles are generated from the registry, so the type's `label` / `description` arrive in every locale (`check-i18n-bundles --write`). Authored in zh-CN (对象扩展), ja-JP (オブジェクト拡張) and es-ES (Extensión de Objeto) on arrival, as `queue` and `assignment_rule` were (`pnpm i18n:extract` then dropped the six provenance rows). The two translation ledgers that count the registry move by the new type: `bare-type-display-echo-decisions.test.ts` (31 → 32 types, 14 → 15 bare, 24 → 26 leaves) and the label positive control in `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (697 → 698), each with its one-line history entry. - **The `__c` judge's door list** (`protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts` header, prose only): names the `object_extension` gate and the adopt-orphans door #28768 added (seat 1's note from that PR's contract review). - `@objectstack/lint/runtime` re-exports `closureDependencyRemedy` (one line), so the gate prints the closure sentence the other save doors print instead of re-spelling it. - `.changeset/28574-object-extension-package-item.md`: minor on `spec`, `lint`, `objectql`, `metadata-protocol`, `runtime`, `platform-objects`. ## Tests `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` (new, 19 tests) over a real better-sqlite3 `SqlDriver`, a real `ObjectQL` engine, the real protocol and `HttpDispatcher.handlePackages` for the export. Fixture: code base `com.acme.crm` owning `crm_account`, its pair `com.acme.crm.custom` installed through `installPackage`, and an unrelated `com.acme.other`. All readings at head `ccfa0893` (after merging `origin/main` with #28768 in), unless named. | Reading | Result | |---|---| | Card file at head | `Tests 19 passed (19)` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0) | | Card file on base `8afaf12d` (every production file of this diff restored to the merge base, the new test kept, five packages rebuilt) | `Tests 18 failed, 1 passed (19)`. On base the type does not exist, so every save answers `'object_extension' is not a metadata type`; the one green is the read-only-base control, refused on base too (400 for the unknown type). Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- .`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt. | The 19 tests: the field on the by-name, list, layered and registry reads with the pair as its only `extend` contributor and the row stored; a draft not live until publish; a record storing a value in the new column; the extension's `validations` reaching the object (the whole body is registered); a boot (`loadMetaFromDb`) re-registering the row; the pair's export carrying `objectExtensions` that parse; the base's export carrying none; that export re-installing into a fresh kernel through `registerApp`; delete and uninstall each removing the field from every read (each asserts it was on every read first); seven refusals, each `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 with its issue path where it has one, leaving no row and no contributor (outside the closure, unknown target, a `.custom` field without `__c`, `defaultRowScope`, `membershipKeys`, a package-less write, a name other than the target); the read-only base refused; and the `excluded` disposition not closing the type to the pair.
Ablations (one per door call, node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs from committed HEAD, package rebuilt and ablation-dist-preflight marker found in dist before each run) - **The save / publish / restore gate.** `objectExtensionItemRefusal`'s type check rewritten to return `undefined` always (marker `ABL1`): blob `796dce22cb1c` → `14a8016fdac0`. `Tests 7 failed, 12 passed (19)`: exactly the seven refusals. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. - **The `'extend'` registration.** `registerStoredObjectExtension`'s `registry.registerObjectExtension(...)` call guarded off (marker `ABL2`): blob `bf4d4c0f79a5` → `cc5b2b90db49`. `Tests 7 failed, 12 passed (19)`: the reads, draft-then-publish, record, validations, boot, delete and uninstall tests. Restored clean. - **The export leg.** `objectExtensions` dropped from the export loop (marker `ABL3`): blob `eec70a607e34` → `ffbfc47a15cc`. `Tests 2 failed, 17 passed (19)`: the export test and the re-install test. Restored clean; runtime rebuilt, `--absent` preflight green, card file 19/19 again. - A first export ablation run in the same chain read 9 red because metadata-protocol's dist still carried `ABL2` (the ablation tool restores source only); it was discarded and re-run alone on a rebuilt dist. The reading above is that second run.
Full suites and typecheck at head ccfa0893 (each under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0) | Suite | Result | |---|---| | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` | 295 files passed, 4 skipped · 22069 tests passed, 26 skipped | | `@objectstack/objectql` (local) | 518 files · 9959 tests | | `@objectstack/runtime` (local) | 509 files · 8247 tests passed, 19 skipped | | `@objectstack/spec` | 875 files · 24715 tests, 1 todo | | `@objectstack/lint` | 189 files · 7814 tests | | `@objectstack/platform-objects` | 107 files · 1497 tests | | `registry-extension-system-columns.test.ts` + `registry-object-extension-nonenumerated-prop-discard.test.ts` | 2 files · 16 tests | | showcase `test/coverage.test.ts`; cli `generate-file-name-registry-parity.test.ts` | 13 / 43 tests | | `tsc --noEmit` spec, lint, objectql, metadata-protocol, runtime, showcase | exit 0 each (pre-final-merge head; `check:type-check-debt` re-measured at head: 0 errors) | | `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 11 changed TS files | exit 0 |
Derived gates `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head: 117 families. All 117 exit 0; `--ran`: **117 derived, 117 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. On the way: `check:i18n` red until the translation bundles were regenerated for the new registry row; `check:query-options-erasure` red on two `as any` casts in the new test, removed; `check:generated` / `check:docs` red after each merge until `gen:docs`; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 on the shallow clone until its fixture commit was fetched. No gate was added.
## Acceptance notes - **Two costs of the spec ruling, on purpose.** `/meta/types` serves no JSON schema for `object_extension`, and a draft carries no `_diagnostics` badge: the type is not bound in `BUILTIN_METADATA_TYPE_SCHEMAS`, because that map requires the ADR-0010 envelope, which would change the schema a manifest's `objectExtensions` parse with. - **`excluded` does not close the type to a pair.** `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` lists `object_extension` as `excluded` (it never replaces a base item, so it never carries `overrides`); the pair's save is admitted regardless. Pinned by the last test. - **Withdrawal is a new registry verb, not `subtractExtenderContributions`.** The order and card name `subtractExtenderContributions` for delete. Measured, that is the fold's idempotency helper (it removes from a base the `indexes` an extender is about to re-add, `registry.ts`); it removes no contributor. `withdrawObjectExtension` splices the package's `extend` contributor and drops the merged-object cache entry. - **The round trip goes through `registerApp`, the path the export is assembled for.** `assemblePackageManifest`'s own docblock names it: `marketplace-install-local` → `manifestService.register()` → `engine.registerApp()`. `installPackage` (`POST /api/v1/packages`) parses `PackageInstallManifestSchema`, which refuses every collection key but `objects` (measured on spec dist at head: `views`, `flows` and `objectExtensions` all answer "Unrecognized key(s)"), so no export carrying views or flows was ever an `installPackage` input. No second code path was written. - **The export fix to `objects`** is a defect this card makes reachable (an extending package's export), fixed where the extension leg is added. - **Outside the claimed file surface:** `packages/lint/src/runtime.ts` (one re-export line), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/reference-sites.ts` (the walk above), the `protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts` header (prose), the regenerated reference pages and translation bundles, and the two translation-ledger count pins. Each is forced by the registry row or asked by seat 1. - **Package-less rows and adopt-orphans.** A package-less `object_extension` save is refused by the gate's first step (pinned). Whether the adopt-orphans door should judge `object_extension` rows it rebinds is left open in the report, not widened here. - **Open question for N-23c (#28575):** whether Studio's add-field needs the type bound in `BUILTIN_METADATA_TYPE_SCHEMAS` (JSON schema and `_diagnostics`), which needs a ruling on the envelope. Recorded in the report. - Serial: #28728 (#28565), #28693 (#28412), #28770 (#28717) and #28768 (#28735) landed while this was in flight. `origin/main` was merged three times (after #28728 / #28693, after main moved ten more commits, and after #28768), each with no conflict, and every reading in this body was retaken after the last one. `registerObjectExtension` hands the whole body, so `fieldPatches` reaches #28565's apply unchanged. ## Verification Live probe on the stock showcase at head `ad2bfc9c` (this diff merged with `origin/main` once; the later commits change only tests, translations, prose and the file pattern), `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 3917` in `examples/app-showcase`, signed in as the seeded admin (`POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email` with `Origin: http://localhost:3917`, cookie jar). `B=http://localhost:3917/api/v1`. ```text POST $B/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization 201 {"packageId":"com.example.showcase.custom","namespace":"showcase_custom","created":true,"writable":true} PUT $B/meta/object_extension/showcase_account?package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft {"extend":"showcase_account","fields":{"region__c":{"type":"text","label":"Region"}}} 200 Saved object_extension 'showcase_account' (env-wide, package=com.example.showcase.custom, state=draft) [seq=1] POST $B/meta/object_extension/showcase_account/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom 200 Published draft — type=object_extension, name=showcase_account [seq=2] GET $B/meta/object/showcase_account 200 item.fields.region__c = {"label":"Region","type":"text",...} (item._packageId com.example.showcase) GET $B/meta/object/showcase_account/layers 200 code.fields.region__c present, effective.fields.region__c present GET $B/packages/com.example.showcase/customizations 200 {"extensions":[{"object":"showcase_account","kind":"field","name":"region__c"}],"counts":{"extensions":1,...}} (the pair's 'extend' contributor, read off the registry) GET $B/meta/object_extension?package=com.example.showcase.custom 200 {"items":[{"extend":"showcase_account","fields":{"region__c":{...}},"_packageId":"com.example.showcase.custom"}]} GET $B/packages/com.example.showcase.custom/export 200 objectExtensions: [{"extend":"showcase_account","fields":{"region__c":{"type":"text","label":"Region"}}}], objects: [] POST $B/data/showcase_account {"name":"Probe Co","region__c":"EMEA"} 201 record.region__c = "EMEA" PUT $B/meta/object_extension/showcase_account?package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft {"extend":"showcase_account","fields":{"region":{"type":"text"}}} 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, issues[0].path "fields.region": name it `region__c`, or change a base field's display properties in the extension's patch (`fieldPatches`). DELETE $B/meta/object_extension/showcase_account?package=com.example.showcase.custom 200 Deleted object_extension 'showcase_account' — it no longer exists. [seq=3] GET $B/meta/object/showcase_account → region__c absent GET $B/packages/com.example.showcase.custom/export → no objectExtensions ``` Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`, 19/19. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01FEkQ5kkSYvKhs52WGfTj3c)_
